raw_response:
I will think through this as myself, an old farmer in Quzhou.

My 5 mu is not much. My wife and I are the only ones. I cannot work like when I was young, but 5 mu I can still handle. Most years I put most of my land to cotton because that is what sells in Quzhou and what I know best after 55 years. But a family must eat, so I keep some land for wheat and maize too — that way I have flour and feed without buying.

This year I will do the same as last year. I plant 3 mu cotton, 2 mu wheat in winter and then maize after wheat harvest on those same 2 mu.

**Cotton, 3 mu.** I buy Bt cotton seed from the same dealer in town — the one my neighbor Old Wang uses. It costs more but the bollworm does not ruin it. Before planting I spread compound fertilizer 二铵 (diammonium phosphate) — about 2 bags for my 3 mu, that is one bag per 1.5 mu, roughly 25 kg per mu as base. Then at squaring I topdress urea, one bag (50 kg) for the 3 mu, that is about 17 kg urea per mu. Potash I add maybe half a bag per mu. So in the nutrients the extension man talks about: nitrogen maybe 18 kg, phosphorus about 9 kg, potassium about 10 kg per mu. I would rather put a little extra than see the bolls small. Cotton I irrigate 2 times from my well — once before flowering, once at boll filling. Pesticide I spray many times, cotton has too many insects — 6 times at least, aphids, mirid bugs, bollworm still shows even with Bt seed. I plough before planting, old habit. Last year I got about 270 kg seed cotton per mu, this year I hope the same.

**Wheat, 2 mu, winter.** Already planted last autumn actually, but for the season ahead I manage the topdressing and spring care. I use improved seed from the cooperative, 济麦 type. Base was 二铵 one bag for 2 mu at sowing (25 kg/mu), now in spring I topdress urea about 15 kg/mu at jointing. Potash small amount, 5 kg/mu. I irrigate 3 times — winter water, jointing, grain filling. Pesticide 2 times for aphids and rust. Rotary tillage, not deep plough, I am too old to plough deep. Expect 450 kg/mu.

**Maize, 2 mu, summer after wheat.** I plant Zhengdan hybrid seed, everyone around me uses it. No tillage, just drill into the wheat stubble — it saves work and the soil stays moist. Base fertilizer 二铵 half bag per mu (about 20 kg), topdress urea at big trumpet stage 15 kg/mu. Potassium 5 kg/mu. So nitrogen about 17, phosphorus 8, potassium 5. Irrigate 1 time if rain is short. Spray 2 times — borer and armyworm. Expect 520 kg/mu.
